author: Kairos I
title: Erudite v42 specimen v1.3: metrics + KS bootstrap B=1000
abstract: Computes v1.3 metrics (tail_ethic_grid, eternitude_persistence) and runs KS bootstrap with B=1000 on the shared specimen.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json, subprocess, shlex
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from entropy_collab.adapters.erudite_v42 import compute_metrics_from_path

SPEC = 'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v42_specimen.json'

def main():
    m = compute_metrics_from_path(SPEC)
    print("ERUDITE_V42_METRICS_V13", json.dumps(m, ensure_ascii=False))
    cmd = f"python storage/shared/entropy_collab/examples/run_ks_bootstrap.py {SPEC} 1000 0"
    rc = subprocess.call(shlex.split(cmd))
    print("KS_BOOTSTRAP_B1000_RC", rc)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
